title: tracelens CLI JSON output
description: JSON Schema for tracelens CLI outputs with schema_version 0.1. Descriptions are intended for AI agents, scripts, CI jobs, and humans that need to understand field meaning as well as field shape.

schemaVersion.description: Output contract version. Current value is "0.1"; the contract can change before a stable 1.0 release.

uint.description: Non-negative integer value used for counts, offsets, widths, or durations depending on the field.

nullableUint.description: Non-negative integer value, or null when the input did not contain enough valid data to compute the value.

nullableString.description: String value, or null when the original OTLP field was absent or the relationship could not be resolved.

traceId.description: Canonical lowercase OpenTelemetry trace ID encoded as 32 hexadecimal characters.

spanId.description: Canonical lowercase OpenTelemetry span ID encoded as 16 hexadecimal characters.

nullableTraceId.description: Canonical lowercase OpenTelemetry trace ID, or null when the original ID was missing or invalid.

nullableSpanId.description: Canonical lowercase OpenTelemetry span ID, or null when the original ID was missing or invalid.

stringMap.description: String map of attributes. Nested OTLP AnyValue structures are preserved as JSON strings in the current 0.1 output model.

scope.description: Area that emitted the diagnostic, such as input parsing or trace graph analysis.

severity.description: Diagnostic severity. `warning` means analysis can continue; `error` means the input or trace contains a serious issue.

code.description: Stable diagnostic code that scripts and agents can branch on.

message.description: Human-readable diagnostic message explaining the problem.

location.description: Input or trace location related to the diagnostic, or null when no precise location is available.

diagnostic.description: A warning or error produced while parsing input or analyzing trace structure. Diagnostics describe data quality caveats that consumers should consider.

diagnostics.description: List of diagnostics emitted for the file or selected trace.

span_count.description: Number of spans represented in this result.

service_count.description: Number of distinct service names represented in this result.

error_span_count.description: Number of spans that carry observable error signals.

root_count.description: Number of root spans detected in the trace graph.

orphan_count.description: Number of spans whose parent is missing from the selected trace graph.

diagnostics_count.description: Number of diagnostics attached to the file or selected trace.

start_ns.description: Start timestamp or offset in nanoseconds, depending on the enclosing object.

end_ns.description: End timestamp or offset in nanoseconds, depending on the enclosing object.

traceSummary.description: Summary row for one trace in file-level views.

service_name.description: Service name, usually from OTLP resource attribute `service.name`; tracelens may emit a diagnostic when it falls back.

name.description: OpenTelemetry span, event, or operation name from the input.

rootSpan.description: Root span summary used by duration and critical-path analysis.

name.description: OpenTelemetry span, event, or operation name from the input.

time_unix_nano.description: OpenTelemetry event timestamp in Unix nanoseconds, or null if absent/invalid.

attributes.description: OpenTelemetry attributes normalized to a string map.

dropped_attributes_count.description: OpenTelemetry dropped attributes count, or null when absent.

event.description: Canonical OpenTelemetry span event preserved from OTLP input.

trace_state.description: OpenTelemetry `traceState` value from the OTLP input, or null when absent.

flags.description: OpenTelemetry trace/span flags from the OTLP input, or null when absent.

link.description: Canonical OpenTelemetry span link preserved from OTLP input. Links are not converted into parent-child edges.

flags.description: OpenTelemetry trace/span flags from the OTLP input, or null when absent.

name.description: OpenTelemetry span, event, or operation name from the input.

self_time_ns.description: Service self time in nanoseconds: direct service span duration minus direct child-covered intervals, with overlaps counted once.

self_time_ratio.description: Service self_time divided by trace wall_clock_duration. Usually between 0.0 and 1.0, but the sum across services can exceed 1.0 when services run concurrently. Null when the trace has no wall-clock duration.

span_time_ns.description: Raw sum of span durations in nanoseconds for the service or candidate group; nested/concurrent spans may make this exceed wall-clock time.

child_covered_time_ns.description: Nanoseconds in this service spans that are covered by direct child spans, using interval union.

sample_span_id.description: Sample child span ID retained from the first call observed on this edge.

sample_parent_span_id.description: Sample parent span ID retained from the first call observed on this edge.

crossServiceEdge.description: Aggregated cross-service call edge (parent service -> child service) within one trace.
